title: WaveFlow-UIE: A Single-Pipeline Wavelet-Domain Flow Model for Efficient Underwater Image Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2611.15457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Underwater image restoration remains challenging because color distortion, scattering, and detail loss affect low- and high-frequency image components differently. Recent diffusion-based methods have shown strong restoration quality, but often rely on multi-stage pipelines and costly iterative refinement. We present WaveFlow-UIE, a single-pipeline wavelet-domain flow model that directly learns to transform degraded underwater wavelet representations into clean ones. Our method applies a discrete wavelet transform, estimates lightweight physics-inspired degradation cues including transmission and ambient light, and conditions a velocity network trained with flow matching in wavelet space. The training objective combines flow-matching, frequency-weighted reconstruction, perceptual, color-consistency, and physics-consistency losses. Across UIEB, LSUI, UFO-120, and EUVP, WaveFlow-UIE achieves a strong quality-efficiency tradeoff, with espe

translated_title: WaveFlow-UIE：一种用于高效水下图像复原的单流水线小波域流模型
translated_abstract: 水下图像复原仍然具有挑战性，因为色彩失真、散射和细节丢失对图像低频和高频分量的影响各不相同。近期基于扩散的方法展现出强大的复原质量，但通常依赖多阶段流水线和代价高昂的迭代细化。我们提出了WaveFlow-UIE，这是一种单流水线的小波域流模型，可直接学习将退化的水下小波表示转换为干净的小波表示。我们的方法应用离散小波变换，估计轻量级的物理启发式退化线索（包括透射率和环境光），并以小波空间中通过流匹配训练的速度网络为条件。训练目标结合了流匹配损失、频率加权重建损失、感知损失、色彩一致性损失和物理一致性损失。在UIEB、LSUI、UFO-120和EUVP数据集上，WaveFlow-UIE取得了出色的质量与效率权衡。
tldr: WaveFlow-UIE提出了一种单流水线小波域流匹配模型，直接将退化水下图像的小波表示转换为干净表示，并结合多重损失函数，在多个基准数据集上实现了出色的质量与效率平衡。
